dataset: Marshall Fire 2021 evacuation points, evacuation centers and shelters named in official sources
interpretation: The Lafayette YMCA matches an OSM sports_centre named only 'YMCA' at (40.0126, -105.1347) in Lafayette; the only other YMCA-named features in the facility query are a sports field beside it and the Mapleton Center YMCA in Boulder. Opening times are when the EOC log first names a site, not verified door-opening times. No capacities or occupancy counts are published in the accessed sources. Locations are geocoded only by matching the public facility name to an OpenStreetMap feature in the 2021-12-30 attic snapshot; unresolved sites keep null geometry. The Longmont Memorial Building and Longmont Senior Center served the separate Middle Fork Fire and are excluded.
